title: Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.2): Implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 1 introduces implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef data types, allowing direct assignment in both directions without calling GetTable or SetTable methods. This simplifies code when working with dynamic table references, available in runtime version 15.2 and above.
key_points: Record variables can now be directly assigned to RecordRef with implicit conversion, replacing GetTable calls
RecordRef can be assigned directly to Record variables, replacing SetTable calls
The feature requires runtime version 15.2 or above; earlier versions show AL0122 compilation errors
Implicit assignment does not copy filters and views, unlike SetTable with the temporary parameter
SetTable method with temporary parameter remains necessary for temporary record scenarios
features: Direct assignment between Record and RecordRef

quotes.text: We have introduced support for implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef instances, allowing direct assignment between these types.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core feature that simplifies AL code by eliminating the need for GetTable and SetTable method calls

quotes.text: in runtime version 15.2 or above, we can do this directly through the assignment statement, RecordRef := Record.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the exact runtime requirement and the new syntax developers should use

quotes.text: This does not replace RecordRef.SetTable(Record, Boolean) Method, for example, MyRecordRef.SetTable(TempCust, true).
quotes.why_it_matters: Important limitation showing that SetTable is still required for temporary records where the two-parameter form is necessary
